title: Standing Down
summary: Brannoc wants to see the legion in the barrows that never deserted anything, and stand with it once, the way he never stood with anyone.

steps.journal: Hold the stairs-down hall of the Old Barrows' second floor (or deeper) for five waves.

objectives.label: Waves held in a hall, floor 2 or deeper

ready: Talk to Brannoc (tap his card, then Talk).
done: He stood. They stood. Afterwards he broke the last link off his old chain and gave you the rest.
